method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 次日早晨雾把大海从她眼前藏了起来。
facts.anchor: Fog hides the ocean from her the next morning.

facts.fact: 她煮咖啡，整个第一杯时间里一直查看车道等 Eeling。
facts.anchor: She makes coffee and keeps checking the driveway for Eeling throughout the first cup.

facts.fact: 中午左右她当天第一次真正觉得饿，开始相信他不会来了。
facts.anchor: Around noon when she’s really becoming hungry for the first time that day, she starts to believe he won’t show.

facts.fact: 一小时后她吃掉了前一晚剩下的披萨，确信他不会来。
facts.anchor: An hour later, after she’s eaten some of the leftover pizza from the night before, she’s sure of it.

facts.fact: 她望着空车道骂了句“You bastard”。
facts.anchor: “You bastard,” she says, looking down the empty driveway.

facts.fact: 二十分钟后电话响起，她以为庆功太早了。
facts.anchor: When her phone rings twenty minutes later she thinks the victory lap was all premature.

facts.fact: 她意识到自己从没给过 Eeling 电话号码。
facts.anchor: she realizes she’s never given him her number

facts.fact: Sloan 打电话开口就说客房楼上有一箱书。
facts.anchor: “There’s a box of books upstairs in the guest room,” Sloan says as a greeting.

facts.fact: Hattie 叹了口气（变成轻笑）后让 Sloan 煮好新咖啡，她会在煮好时到。
facts.anchor: Put a fresh pot of coffee on, I’ll be over by the time it’s ready.
